dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (日医標準レセプトソフト); GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL-based, uses COPY copybooks like COMMON-SPA, W01COMMON-SPA, ENUM-VALUE typical of ORCA

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software - staff/employee information management screen (職員情報 W06)
purpose.summary: This program implements the staff/employee information management screen (component W06) of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It handles registration, update, and deletion of staff records including occupation codes, user IDs, authority flags, and various system settings. It is a multi-page screen program managing system administration information for a Japanese medical clinic management system.

notable_features: 73 COPY statements indicating heavy use of shared copybooks
267 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
Japanese EUC/Shift-JIS encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
SPA (Screen Parameter Area) pattern typical of ORCA
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses ORCA middleware abstraction layer
Version history spanning 2000-2010 with multiple contributors
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are Japanese EUC or Shift-JIS encoded, appearing as mojibake. This is the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt software, widely deployed in Japanese clinics. The program is a screen handler for staff information settings, part of the system management subsystem. Fixed format with max line length 74, consistent with ORCA codebase conventions.
